url.description: Starting HTTP or HTTPS website URL to crawl.

tags.description: Usage-tracking tags. Provide at most 20 tags of 1-50 characters each.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth from the starting URL. Use 0 to analyze only the starting page; omit for no crawl-depth limit.

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to analyze (1-50). Higher values increase the price.

fact_check.description: Require every returned value to be grounded in page content. Unsupported fields are returned as null or empty instead of inferred.

instructions.description: Optional extraction guidance or field interpretation, up to 2000 characters.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema describing the object to extract. Add descriptions to non-obvious properties so the extractor can interpret them correctly.

stop_after_ms.description: Soft crawl time budget in milliseconds (10000-110000).

follow_subdomains.description: Follow links on subdomains of the starting domain.

phone.description: Phone-number hint for transaction lookup, as text or a number.

country.description: Country hint for name or transaction lookup.

max_speed.description: Prefer faster but potentially less comprehensive retrieval.

identifier.description: Domain, company name, work email, ticker, full direct URL, or transaction descriptor matching lookup_type.

max_age_ms.description: Maximum cached brand-data age in milliseconds. The provider clamps values to 1 day through 1 year.

timeout_ms.description: Provider timeout in milliseconds, from 1000 through 300000.

lookup_type.description: Kind of identifier supplied in identifier. Selects domain, company name, work email, stock ticker, direct URL, or transaction lookup.

force_language.description: Provider-supported output language name, such as english or french.

ticker_exchange.description: Stock exchange identifier for ticker lookup; omit to let Context.dev default to NASDAQ.

high_confidence_only.description: For transaction lookup, require additional match verification.

merchant_category_code.description: Merchant Category Code hint for transaction lookup, as text or a number.
